description: Monthly Motor Fuel - Gasoline Volumes Distributed is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. Volume of gasoline reported by the States each month, based on reports from suppliers and distributors. These amounts are reported in various Office of Highway Policy Information (OHPI) products including the longstanding Monthly Motor Fuel Report, and the annual Highway Statistics publications. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 6 columns, among them DATA TYPE, MONTH, VOL GASOLINE, STATE, YEAR, DATE MODIFIED. The portal shows 2026-08-21 as the last data update. Attribution given: FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
